title: Carbon footprint of oil produced through enhanced oil recovery using carbon dioxide directly captured from air
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01752A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Antonio Gasós, Ronny Pini, Viola Becattini, Marco Mazzotti
Can oil production be carbon neutral? A general top-down analysis shows that DAC CO2-EOR may seem so if only the EOR phase is considered—but full reservoir life cycle accounting reveals that true carbon neutrality is physically unachievable.
